name: Honeydew
notes: - **All Tabs** opens scrolled to the tab you were on, instead of the top.

beta.name: Honeydew
beta.notes:
- **Extensions:** add-ons that ask for an always-running background page (like ClearURLs) install instead of failing.
- **All Tabs:** swiping a tab away only works from the middle of its card, so a swipe near its edge or title slides between Private, Tabs and Temporary instead of closing the tab by accident.
